## Checklist
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes with the database running
- [ ] One topic per pull request
- [ ] No domain-specific code in `src/` (use a preset under `examples/`)
- [ ] Docs (README, wiki, CHANGELOG) updated if behaviour changed, and the description says which part they touch: the Quick start (plain words, no retrieval terms) or the reference (the wiki)
